title: Senior Mechanic (Heavy Equipment)
description:
Summary
The Senior Mechanic specializing in Heavy Equipment is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and optimizing a wide range of heavy machinery used in construction, mining, and other industrial sectors. This role requires extensive knowledge of heavy equipment mechanics, hydraulics, and electronics, along with a commitment to safety and efficiency.
Duties and Responsibilities
Conduct regular maintenance and repair on heavy equipment such as bulldozers, cranes, excavators, and loaders.
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues including hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical systems.
Perform complex repairs and component replacements, ensuring equipment operates efficiently and safely.
Lead and mentor junior mechanics in repair techniques and preventive maintenance of heavy machinery.
Oversee the maintenance records and inventory of parts and supplies for heavy equipment.
Collaborate with equipment operators to understand equipment issues and provide effective solutions.
Stay updated with the latest technological advancements in heavy machinery and repair techniques.
Ensure compliance with all safety guidelines and regulations during maintenance and repair operations.
Coordinate with the management team to plan and schedule maintenance activities and minimize equipment downtime.
Provide emergency repair service as needed to prevent delays in project timelines.
Job Requirements
Advanced diploma or equivalent in mechanics, heavy equipment maintenance, or related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in heavy equipment repair and maintenance.
In-depth knowledge of heavy equipment systems, including hydraulic, electronic, and engine components.
Proficiency in using diagnostic tools and equipment for heavy machinery.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
Strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor team members.
Commitment to maintaining a safe work environment, with knowledge of OSHA safety standards.
Physical ability to handle heavy equipment and work in various environmental conditions.
Flexibility to respond to emergency repair requests outside of standard working hours.
Others
Joining our team as a Senior Mechanic specializing in Heavy Equipment offers a challenging yet rewarding career path, where you will be instrumental in ensuring the functionality and reliability of critical machinery. We value dedication, skill, and a strong work ethic, and provide opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
